description: Name UI elements by colour (and optionally monitor and region) so every later call can say touch {name:"DOUBLE"} or expect {rect:{name:"HIT"}} instead of coordinates. Pixel-font text cannot be read, so read a label off one screenshot once, then label it. set: {NAME: {color:"#f15c5c", peripheral?, region?:{x1,y1,x2,y2}}}. save/load persist them in worlds/labels/<file>.json so they survive sessions. craftos_ui shows the names inline. Call with nothing to list.

save.description: Save the labels as this name.

name: craftos_labels
